important_order_limits: The common $newloc_update_slave is used for assistant too. $recalc_assistant_mood is defined at905 but has no QSP call references.
The $recalc_slave_mood path calls equipment recalculation again at816; preserve current engine order instead of deleting the apparent duplicate.
Paired quests create both a slave and assistant. Refresh slave first, then assistant as the actual main-screen list does.
$recalc_slave_mood:864 reads shared slave_psy_hardness before $newloc_update_slave:1089 assigns it for the current role, so changing iteration order may alter intermediate mood caps.
An extra gs '$slave_price' after $newloc_update_slave is a second repair/value pass, not a necessary part of the observed newloc update.
rating, slaveprice, skill_sum and related calculations use shared globals. Capture them per role when needed; after a multi-role loop they refer to the last updated existing role.

		if $args[0] ! 'ignore gifts':
			if dynslave_inventory['plaid'] > 0: dynamic $replace($item_property['plaid'], 'dyn'+'slave', 'dynslave')
			if dynslave_inventory['stuffed_toy'] > 0: dynamic $replace($item_property['stuffed_toy'], 'dyn'+'slave', 'dynslave')

jo9_pool_old=jo9_pool_last-jo9_pool_first+1
jo9_pool_pick=args[1]
